channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: Double Feature Comedy Night feat. Dan Alten and Carson Taylor (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Saturday 10/10 · 7:00 PM (doors 6:00 PM) | Crescent Theater | from $20.56. Whipper Snapper Comedy presents Double Feature Comedy Night at the Crescent Theater in Mobile on Saturday, October 10. Two feature comedians, Dan Alten and Carson Taylor, perform back to back like an old double feature. Doors open at 6:00 PM, the show starts at 7:00 PM, and the show is 18 and up.

item.title: Game Days at Marina Bar & Grill (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Thursday 10/1 | Marina Bar & Grill, Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. Marina Bar & Grill at Baytowne Marina runs its own Game Days program, showing NCAA football on Saturdays and NFL games on Sundays plus select Monday and Thursday nights. It sits right on the marina at Sandestin.

item.title: Hermit Crab Races at CRABS on the Beach (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Saturdays 10/10 and 10/17 · 5:00 PM and 6:00 PM | CRABS on the Beach | Free. CRABS on the Beach races purple pincher hermit crabs in its playground on Saturday, October 10 and Saturday, October 17, with races at 5:00 PM and 6:00 PM. The restaurant says it has run the races free of charge for smaller guests for 23 years. The crabs are native to Honduras and Chile and live in trees near the ocean.

item.title: Indios Amigos Traveling Exhibit at Gulf Breeze and Pace Libraries (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Wednesday 10/7 to Saturday 10/10 at Gulf Breeze · Monday 10/12 to Saturday 10/17 at Pace | Gulf Breeze Library, then Pace Library | No published price. Gulf Breeze Library and then Pace Library host a bilingual traveling exhibit from the Florida Public Archaeology Network for Hispanic Heritage Month. It tells the story of the Aztec artisans and warriors who sailed with Tristan de Luna's 1559 expedition to Pensacola. The display stays up all week at each branch, so it fits a quick stop on a library visit.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Tuesday 9/15 | West Regional Library | No published price. West Regional Library hosts this youth exhibition tied to the Jazz Art Writers South Festival, a partnership between Mobile Arts Council and Amp Up Arts. More than 50 paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 line the space, each interpreting jazz through color and line. No viewing hours are published for Tuesday, September 15, so call the library to confirm.

item.title: Karaoke & DJ Nights: FUBAR Pizza Bar (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Nightly · 9 PM-1 AM | FUBAR Pizza Bar | Free. Late-night karaoke runs five nights a week (Sun, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat) plus a DJ on Monday and Thursday, 9 PM to 1 AM every night, with pizza till close. It is in Fort Walton Beach.

item.title: Karaoke Block: The Block (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Wed-Sat · from 6 PM (Thu 8 PM) | The Block | Free. The Sports & Karaoke room at The Block runs Wednesday through Saturday, opening at 6 (8 on Thursday) and going late. It is downtown Fort Walton Beach.

item.title: Live Music: Manci's Antique Club (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Thu 6:30 PM · Fri-Sat 7:30 PM · Sun 6:00 PM | Manci's Antique Club | Free. This Daphne institution has walls of Jim Beam decanters and live local bands Thursday through Sunday. It is a grown-up night out.

item.title: Live Music: Paradise Bar & Grill (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Tue/Fri/Sat 5:30 PM · Sun 2:30 PM | Paradise Bar & Grill | Free. Beachside live music plays most nights on Pensacola Beach, with rotating local acts starting at 5:30 (Sundays 2:30). Wine Down Wednesday runs $3 house and $6 premium wines all day.

item.title: Make It Last: Gallery Exhibition at UWF (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Weekdays through 11/20 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM · opening reception Thursday 10/8 · 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM | UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, Building 82, The Art Gallery | Free. Make It Last is an exhibition in The Art Gallery at the UWF Center for Fine and Performing Arts, curated by a UWF graduate. Six artists share the space, which includes a conversation pit in the gallery alcove and a poetry wall that visitors fill with their own work. Admission is free, and the opening reception on October 8 runs from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

item.title: Make Your Own Glass (hot glass, by appointment) (SAT 10/10)
item.description: By appointment: Wednesdays 5 PM-9 PM, Saturdays 8 AM-11 AM | First City Art Center | from $85. Make Your Own Glass is a hands-on hot glass session at First City Art Center in Pensacola, where each participant makes a piece with a glassblower. It's for ages 8 and up including adults, by appointment on Wednesdays from 5-9 PM and Saturdays from 8-11 AM. The finished piece cools in an annealing oven and is picked up the following week. Standard pieces cost $85, and premium pieces such as a pumpkin, ornament, cup or bowl cost $110-$140.

item.title: MONOCHROME exhibition (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Sunday 9/27 to Saturday 10/24 · times not posted | Blue Morning Gallery | No published price. Monochrome is a group show by three artists at Blue Morning Gallery, 21 S. Palafox Place in downtown Pensacola, running through Saturday, October 24. The black-and-white work asks what you notice, such as shadow angles, line curves and surface grain. The First Friday reception was October 2 and has passed.

item.title: Ocean Hour Beach Cleanup (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Saturdays · start time and site posted each week | Rotating, Pensacola Beach / area waterfronts | Free. Give an hour and leave the beach better. Buckets, grabbers, and gloves are provided. It is a service morning that fits the family's values and is kid-friendly.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Pensacola: paint-and-sip, family paint days and date nights (weekly programme) (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Classes most days: family days Saturday 10:30 AM, brunch Sunday 11 AM, evenings Wednesday to Saturday | Painting with a Twist Pensacola | $35 per family. Painting with a Twist Pensacola is an artist-led paint-and-sip studio at 4771 Bayou Blvd Suite C11 with several classes every week. October has family paint days (ages 6 and up with a parent, no alcohol), adult Paint & Sip and Date Night classes (ages 16 and up on date nights), Halloween-themed canvases and Paint Your Pet. Classes cost $35-$60 depending on the class, and alcohol is sold on site with no BYOB.

item.title: Pensacola Beach Songwriters Festival (cherry-pick sets) (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Oct 1-11 · venue-by-venue schedule | 22+ venues, Pensacola Beach + downtown | Free. Ten days of acoustic storyteller rounds run, mostly free, a build-your-own date. Many venues are bars; the cleaner picks are the daytime Gulfside Pavilion sets and restaurant listening rooms (Native Café, Flounders dinner sets).

item.title: Pensacola Stand-Up Comedy Show: Liv Smith and Daniel Arnold (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Saturday 10/10 · 8:00 PM · doors 7:30 PM | BagelHeads Downtown | from $20. Two Charleston comedians bring a slice of the Charleston comedy scene to BagelHeads Downtown for one night. Liv Smith mixes stories about her nights out with sharp takes on current events and everyday nonsense. Jeremy Young hosts, parking is free and guests bring their own beverages.

item.title: Pilates and Pumpkins at Holland Farms (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Saturday 10/10 · 6:00 AM to 8:00 AM · pilates 6 AM to 7 AM · pumpkin painting 7 AM to 8 AM | Holland Farms | from $20. Holland Farms starts a Saturday with an hour of pilates at 6:00 AM followed by an hour of pumpkin painting at 7:00 AM. The class costs $20, and the pumpkin painting add-on is $5 and includes one pumpkin. Bring a yoga mat, grip socks, water and a towel.

item.title: Pokémon League at GameMasters Guild (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Thursdays 3 PM-8 PM and Saturdays 12 PM-2 PM | GameMasters Guild | Free. Pokémon League at GameMasters Guild is free casual play for the Pokémon TCG, the Pokémon Champions video game and Pokémon GO. It runs Thursdays from 3 to 8 PM and Saturdays from 12 to 2 PM in Crestview. All ages are welcome, and the shop calls it a family-friendly space. Players get promo cards or special items while supplies last, and a free Pokémon account is needed to qualify (children under 13 register under a parent's account).

item.title: Primal Fear Haunted Attraction at OWA (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Select nights through October 31 · evenings | OWA Parks & Resort | No published price. OWA's immersive haunted attraction runs on select nights through the end of October, with dates including September 25 to 26 and October 2 to 3, 9 to 10, 16 to 17 and 19 to 31. A $7 Zombie Laser Tag add-on is available alongside the main attraction, and tickets are required.

item.title: Repticon Fort Walton Beach: October 2026 (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Sat 10/10 · 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM and Sun 10/11 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM | Destin Fort Walton Beach Fairgrounds and Events Center | from $6. Repticon comes to the Destin Fort Walton Beach Fairgrounds and Events Center Saturday, October 10, 9 AM to 4 PM, and Sunday, October 11, 10 AM to 4 PM. Admission is $15 for adults, $6 for ages 5 to 12, and free for ages 4 and under.

item.title: The Boardwalk Columbus Day Weekend Celebration (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Mon 10/5 to Sun 10/11 · see the daily schedule | The Boardwalk on Okaloosa Island | No published price. The Boardwalk on Okaloosa Island runs a week of Columbus Day programming from October 5 to October 11, new for 2026. The schedule is a pirate show on Monday from 5:30 PM to 8:00 PM, a movie on the beach on Tuesday at 8:00 PM, karaoke on Wednesday from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM, and karaoke followed by a fireworks show on Sunday.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: Weekend Live Music: Sandshaker Lounge (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Every weekend · evenings | Sandshaker Lounge | Free. The Shaker, birthplace of the Bushwacker, has live music every weekend and never a cover. It is a classic Pensacola Beach dive, about 25 minutes from the bridge.

item.title: Gulf Coast Compassion 5K at The Wharf (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Saturday 10/10 · 7:00 AM | The Wharf | from $45. The Wharf in Orange Beach hosts the Gulf Coast Compassion 5K, sponsored by United Rentals, on Saturday, October 10 at 7:00 AM. The course runs along Main Street and Wharf Parkway. Registration is $45 in advance or $55 on race day.

item.title: Monthly Pancake Breakfast at Holley-Navarre Senior Association (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Saturday 10/10 · 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM | Holley-Navarre Senior Association | No published price. The senior center's second-Saturday all-you-can-eat pancake breakfast is open to the whole community, not just members, with proceeds supporting the center. Neither the Chamber's listing nor the center's site publishes a set price; the center asks guests to bring cash since it does not yet take cards.

item.title: Parkrun: Free Timed 5K (Rec Plex North) (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Saturdays · 7:30 AM | UWF Rec Plex North Field | Free. A free, timed, all-comers 5K runs every Saturday. Walk, run, or push the jogging stroller. The kids can earn official times too, with one-time free barcode registration.

item.title: Ride MORE Bicycles Saturday Shop Ride (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Saturdays · 7:30 AM | Ride MORE Bicycles | No published price. The Ride MORE Bicycles Saturday Shop Ride is a weekly road group ride that leaves the shop at 59 E Gregory St. in Pensacola. It covers about 30 miles at a 17-19 mph average, with sprints and regrouping spots. The ride runs 7:30-9:30 AM every Saturday and road bikes are required.

item.title: Run for the Reef, 18th year (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Saturday 10/10 · 7:30 AM | Windjammers on the Pier | No published price. A 10K, a 5K run and walk, and a one mile fun run for ages twelve and under, all starting from the pier at Navarre Beach. The 5K and 10K run out and back along Gulf Blvd. The fun run goes off on the Sea Turtle Center nature trail once the 5K has cleared. The money pays for the Navarre Beach Marine Sanctuary's snorkelling and diving reefs, so the race funds the reef it's named after. An after-race party follows with food and refreshments.

item.title: Shrimp Festival 5K / 10K Run & Walk (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Saturday 10/10 · 7:30 AM | Orange Beach Sportsplex / Hugh S. Branyon Backcountry Trail | No published price. The Shrimp Festival 5K and 10K start on the Backcountry Trail behind the Orange Beach Sportsplex at 7:30 AM on Saturday, October 10. Registration proceeds benefit the Orange Beach and Gulf Shores high school cross-country and track teams. The race repeats every year alongside National Shrimp Festival weekend.

item.title: Yoga with Dolphins (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Saturdays 10/10, 10/24, 11/7, 11/21, 12/12, 12/26 · 7:30 AM-8:30 AM | Gulfarium Marine Adventure Park, Dolphin Oasis | from $40. Yoga with Dolphins is a guided all-levels yoga class at Dolphin Oasis, Gulfarium Marine Adventure Park in Fort Walton Beach, with the park's bottlenose dolphins swimming nearby. An instructor from Prana Yoga teaches it on Saturdays from 7:30-8:30 AM, and general admission is not required. It costs $40 per person.

item.title: Century Lions Club Cross Country 5K (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Saturday 10/10 · 8:00 AM | Anthony Pleasant Park | from $10. The Century Lions Club Cross Country 5K is a community race at Anthony Pleasant Park, 100 SR-4 in Century, organized by the Century Lions Club. It has a runner division and a walker division. Medals and ribbons go to the top three in each of 32 age groups, with overall awards for the first male and first female and separate awards for the top three men and women walkers.

item.title: Ministry Village Clay Shoot (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Saturday 10/10 · 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM | Santa Rosa Shooting Center | No published price. Santa Rosa Shooting Center sets aside the day for Ministry Village Clay Shoot. Call the range closer to the date to register.

item.title: Race for Grace 5K and Harvest Festival (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Sat 10/10/2026 · 5K at 8 AM | Twin Hills Park | from $35. A 5K that raises money for a recovery program, and a harvest festival waiting at the finish with a petting zoo, pumpkin carving, face painting and inflatables. The run is a walk if you want it to be. Entry goes up after September 30, so the cheap week is this one.

item.title: Sea No Limits fishing clinic (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Saturday 10/10 · 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM | Vince J. Whibbs Sr. Community Maritime Park | Free. A free fishing clinic at Maritime Park for children and adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities, and their families. It runs 8:00 AM to noon on the downtown waterfront. Gear and instruction are the point of the morning.

item.title: The Great Bellingrath Harvest (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Daily through 11/8 · 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Bellingrath Gardens and Home | from $11. Bellingrath Gardens and Home runs a fall festival from September 19 through November 8 with seasonal displays across the gardens, including the scarecrow exhibit and pumpkin displays. The gardens are open daily, and the general admission price applies. The events page does not list a separate price for the harvest, so the gardens ticket is the number to plan with.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Oct 31 · 9 AM to 6 PM | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | No published price. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's own page does not print admission prices, so check the ticket page before driving out.

item.title: Anchor Up Monthly Card Show (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Saturday 10/10 · 9:00 AM-4:00 PM | Emerald Fortress | Free. The Anchor Up Monthly Card Show is a sports card and trading card show at Emerald Fortress in Pensacola, on the second Saturday of the month. Expect Pokémon, One Piece TCG, sports cards, slabs and singles, sealed wax and packs, supplies and memorabilia, with live raffles. Admission and parking are free.

item.title: Coastal Alabama Farmers & Fishermens Market (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Saturdays · 9 AM-2 PM | Coastal Alabama Market | Free. The county's largest market sells fresh Gulf seafood straight from the boats plus produce and makers. It is five minutes from OWA, so it stacks with a Tropic Falls day.

item.title: Dauphin Island Art Trail (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Saturday 10/10 · 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM | Cadillac Square Park | Free. The Dauphin Island Art Trail takes over Cadillac Square Park on Saturday, October 10 from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. The outdoor event has art from local artists, food booths, a trolley and a scavenger hunt game. The Dauphin Island Chamber of Commerce sponsors it, and it is free and open to the public.

item.title: Fall Into Family History at Santa Rosa County Libraries (SAT 10/10)
item.description: Wednesday 10/7 Pace · Wednesday 10/14 Jay · Wednesday 10/21 Gulf Breeze · Wednesday 10/28 Navarre · 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM | Santa Rosa County libraries: Pace, Jay, Gulf Breeze and Navarre | No published price. The library system's lead reference specialist visits one branch each Wednesday in October to help people start or extend a family tree. Visitors can bring a specific research question or simply stop by to learn how to get started with the library's genealogy resources. The help runs during regular library hours, so no appointment time is listed.
